nodes.title: Help a user orient inside one workspace
nodes.body: A Brunch session should make the selected workspace and spec feel legible before asking the user to commit new graph truth.

nodes.title: Orientation should follow the selected spec, not the entire workspace
nodes.body: The useful starting frame is the chosen spec's graph state: what is known, what is missing, and which move is now reasonable.

nodes.title: A workspace may hold multiple specs
nodes.body: The same filesystem workspace can contain several Brunch specs with separate sessions and graph truth.

nodes.title: Selection must stay scoped to the chosen spec
nodes.body: No prompt, projection, or follow-up should blend facts from sibling specs unless the user explicitly asks to switch or compare.

nodes.title: Selected spec
nodes.body: The product-facing target of the current session.

detail.definition: The one spec whose graph and sessions a current interaction targets.

nodes.title: Show the selected spec before deeper work begins
nodes.body: The user must be able to see which spec the session is operating on before graph-changing work proceeds.

nodes.title: Teams keep running onboarding notes in a shared doc
nodes.body: Captured from onboarding-notes.md during bulk ingest as outer-band signal. Reviewed and plausible, but not yet harmonized against the selected-spec scope — advisory until the review path confirms or reworks it.

nodes.title: Surface the latest shared onboarding note on session entry
nodes.body: Source-derived from onboarding-notes.md: the notes ask for the newest team note to appear at entry. Advisory — it is in tension with keeping orientation scoped to one spec, so it must be harmonized (promote, rewrite, or supersede) rather than read as a settled commitment.

nodes.title: Users skim orientation top-to-bottom and stop at the first actionable item
nodes.body: Captured from ux-research-summary.md as a reviewed observation. Advisory: it informs how orientation might be ordered but has not been harmonized into a settled constraint.

nodes.title: Rank orientation items by recency
nodes.body: Source-derived from ux-research-summary.md. Advisory signal about presentation order, still pending harmonization against the settled selected-spec framing.

edges.rationale: Multiple specs make orientation necessary before acting.
Workspace-level blending would undermine selected-spec orientation.
The settled requirement expresses the goal as product behavior.
The thesis depends on the selected-spec vocabulary.
Source-derived: the onboarding-note context motivates surfacing the latest note. Advisory link, pending harmonization.
The skim-behavior observation motivates recency ranking. Advisory until harmonized.
